title: Why every developer should learn Rust in 2026

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: In 2026, why should every developer prioritize learning Rust over other languages?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Rust's memory safety and performance make it ideal for embedded systems, blockchain, and real-time applications like autonomous vehicles.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But with power comes responsibility — Rust's low-level control could be misused in surveillance or weaponized AI systems.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are creating tooling and community guidelines to enforce ethical use, like the Rust Foundation's new safety certification program.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where Rust drives ethical tech — from decentralized identity systems to sustainable energy grids — is within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Rust is shaping a future where innovation is both powerful and responsible.

video_cue: A developer writing Rust code on a screen, with visualizations of secure systems in healthcare and transportation.
